root_cause: The /fill endpoint writes 10MB chunks to /tmp/disk_fill_payload inside the inventory-service container until [Errno 28] No space left on device is raised, exhausting the container's writable layer disk allocation
expected_fix: Call DELETE /fill/reset to remove the fill payload file. In production: implement disk usage alerting (e.g. node_exporter disk metrics > 85%), add log rotation, and ensure data directories have separate volume mounts with defined size limits
